description:
We're a growing freight brokerage looking for an Entry Level Data Engineer to help build and maintain the data systems that power our operations. You'll work with our Sales, Account Management, Carrier Sales, and Track & Trace teams to design data solutions that make information more accessible and actionable across the organization. With guidance from our experienced team, you'll develop practical skills in data engineering while making a real impact on our business.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Design and develop data pipelines and ETL workflows that extract, transform, and load freight and logistics data into our systems
 Build data integration solutions that connect our TransportPro TMS platform with other business tools and data sources
 Write clean, maintainable SQL queries and Python scripts to extract, analyze, and prepare data for reporting and analytics
 Create and maintain data quality checks and monitoring tools to ensure accuracy and reliability of operational data
 Collaborate with Sales, Account Management, Carrier Sales, and Track & Trace teams to understand their data needs and translate requirements into technical solutions
 Support the development of foundational analytics and reporting that help teams make better decisions
 Document data pipelines, workflows, and processes clearly so that others can understand and maintain your work
 Troubleshoot data issues and work with the team to resolve problems that impact data reliability
 Learn and apply version control best practices using Git and collaborative development workflows
 Stay curious about emerging data technologies and best practices in data engineering to continuously improve your skills
 
 What You'll Build 
 Data pipelines and ETL workflows that extract, transform, and load freight and logistics data into our systems
 Data integration solutions that connect our TransportPro TMS platform with other business tools and data sources
 Data quality and monitoring tools that ensure accuracy and reliability of operational data
 Foundational analytics and reporting that support decision-making across Sales, Account Management, and Track & Trace teams
 What We're Looking For 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent professional experience)
 Strong foundational Python skills with the ability to write clean, maintainable code
 Solid understanding of SQL and experience querying relational databases for data extraction and analysis
 Familiarity with REST APIs, webhooks, and basic data integration concepts
 Experience with or strong interest in learning ETL tools and data pipeline frameworks
 Proficiency with version control systems (Git) and collaborative development practices
 Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and translate them into technical solutions
 Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail when working with data
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes and explain technical concepts clearly
 Eagerness to learn emerging data technologies and best practices in data engineering
 Freight, logistics, or supply chain industry experience is a plus; familiarity with TMS platforms is advantageous
 What We Offer 
 Competitive salary
 Health, dental, and vision benefits
 Mentorship and professional development opportunities
 Real impact and ownership of meaningful projects from day one
 To Apply: Submit your resume and a brief description of a data pipeline, ETL project, or data integration you've built or contributed to

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
